title: Saudi East–West pipeline shut after Iraq-origin drone strike removes main Hormuz workaround
summary: Saudi Arabia confirmed on Friday that several drones launched from Iraqi territory hit its 1,200 km East–West pipeline in the Riyadh and Medina regions, and Riyadh shut the line as a precaution, removing a corridor that had been moving 4–5 million barrels a day, or roughly 4% of global supply, since the Strait of Hormuz was disrupted. Iraq's prime minister dismissed security commanders in the launch area and ordered three border crossings with Iran closed; three Iran-backed faction commanders told The New Region the attack was carried out by a network linked to a senior IRGC officer.
